required_action: Reclassify all 80 rows source by source from the complete official MS condition; re-evaluate evidence_kind and use POINT_BASED, GROUPED_THRESHOLD, CAPPED_POINTS, CAPPED_SUBSETS, ROW_ATOMIC or STRUCTURAL_CRITERIA only where the source supports it; preserve all caps, subsets, thresholds and linked conditions; rebuild the copied provisional pattern summaries and independently retest.
